info.name: QuickTasker API
info.description: Generated by tests/api/build-collection.js — do not edit by hand. Run with `npm run test:api`.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Creates two boards, stages, a task on board B and API tokens. IDs are stored as collection variables.

item.name: Create full-access token for board A

{
  "name": "Full {{runId}}",
  "get_pipeline": true,
  "patch_pipeline": true,
  "get_pipeline_stages": true,
  "post_pipeline_stages": true,
  "patch_pipeline_stages": true,

  "get_pipeline_tasks": true,
  "post_pipeline_tasks": true,
  "patch_pipeline_tasks": true,
  "delete_pipeline_tasks": true
}

item.name: 01 Token API
item.description: Bearer-token API under /token/board. Every token is scoped to one board and a set of permission flags.

item.name: Token without Bearer prefix is accepted
Token without get_pipeline permission is forbidden
Token is scoped to its own board

exec: pm.test('name updated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.board.name).to.eql('API Board A ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId') + ' renamed'));

item.name: Update stage description only keeps name
Update stage requires at least one field
Cannot update a stage on another board
Cannot delete a stage on another board
Cannot create a task in a stage on another board
Cannot update a task on another board
Cannot move task to a stage on another board

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Stage not found"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Stage not found'));

item.name: Enable "only last stage can be done" setting
Cannot mark done outside last stage when restricted
Disable "only last stage can be done" setting
Cannot mark done a task on another board
Cannot delete stage that has tasks
Cannot delete a task on another board
02 Public API
item.description: Unauthenticated public task submission form API. Uses board A.

item.name: Submitting to a disabled board fails
Status lookup returns the submitted task
Status lookup does not expose non-public tasks
Require logged-in users and reset count
Status shows login required for anonymous visitor
Anonymous submission fails when login is required
Logged-in submission succeeds when login is required
03 User page API
item.description: Public QuickTasker user page app API, authenticated with X-WPQT-USER-PAGE-CODE, X-WPQT-USER-API-Nonce and the wpqt-session-token-{hash} cookie. Rate-limit requests use the qt-rate-limit-helper test plugin (wp-env only).

item.name: Assign second user to "Other user's" task
Create custom field for the user

exec: pm.test('message mentions "User page does not exist"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('User page does not exist'));
pm.test('message mentions "Nonce not provided"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Nonce not provided'));
pm.test('message mentions "Nonce verification failed"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Nonce verification failed'));
pm.test('message mentions "already been completed"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('already been completed'));

item.name: Requests without session cookie are rejected
Session cannot be used on another user's page

exec: pm.test('message mentions "does not match the page hash"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('does not match the page hash'));
pm.test('message mentions "Nonce not provided"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Nonce not provided'));

item.name: Assigned tasks list only the user's tasks
Assignable tasks list free unassigned tasks

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to view"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to view'));

item.name: Cannot view an unassigned private task

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to view"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to view'));
pm.test('returns comments including the new one', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((c) => c.text)).to.include('Task comment ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));
pm.test('contains the comment', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((c) => c.text)).to.include('Task comment ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));

item.name: Cannot comment on another user's task

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to edit"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to edit'));

item.name: Cannot read comments of a task the user is not assigned to

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to view the comments"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to view the comments'));

pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to edit"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to edit'));

item.name: Cannot mark another user's task done

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to edit"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to edit'));

item.name: Assigned task is no longer assignable

exec: pm.test('free task left the assignable list', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((t) => t.task_hash)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('upFreeTaskHash')));

item.name: Cannot self-assign to a task that already has an assignee

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to assign"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to assign'));

item.name: Cannot self-assign to a non-assignable task

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to assign"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to assign'));
pm.test('free task is back in the assignable list', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((t) => t.task_hash)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('upFreeTaskHash')));
pm.test('returns comments including the new one', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((c) => c.text)).to.include('Profile comment ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));
pm.test('contains the profile comment', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map((c) => c.text)).to.include('Profile comment ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));
pm.test('custom field has the new value', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().data.customFields)).to.include('555-0100'));

item.name: Cannot update another user's custom field

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to edit custom fields for this user"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to edit custom fields for this user'));

item.name: Cannot update custom fields of another user's task

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Not allowed to edit task custom fields"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Not allowed to edit task custom fields'));
